note: MEASURED, not inferred: ANDOSOL IS ANTI-CORRELATED WITH TECTONIC UNREST. The Repose baseline probe, 30 seeds (1..=30) at full build depth, 440,715 settleable land cells. Land-cell-weighted andosol share by unrest decile: d0 0.009151, d1 0.006607, d2 0.006012, d3 0.007355, d4 0.006397, d5 0.003927, d6 0.002973, d7 0.001793, d8 0.000386, d9 EXACTLY 0.000000. Monotone decreasing, and it holds separately within each of four elevation bands, so it is not an artifact of band-mixing. Deciles are NOT degenerate: 44,044 to 44,149 land cells each. Mechanism candidate, not yet confirmed: classify_soil gates Andosol on volcanic parent rock AND mean_temp_c above 5.0 (lithology.rs:737-743), and high-unrest ground runs colder within a band. Why it matters: the intuitive reading that volcanic ground is the fertile ground is FALSE in this model, on top of the separate finding that soil never reaches settlement siting at all. Anyone writing a spec premise about volcanic fertility should read both facts first. Settlements DO over-occupy high-unrest ground (x1.6 upland, x2.5 highland, x5.5 montane, flat in lowland) -- so the attraction is running through the mineral prospectivity channel, not through soil.
